objective: Yggdrasil R3 add an episode-persistent learned public transition graph + finite optimistic lookahead. An unchanged Yggdrasil R2 source/weights governs real local inhibitory credit; new graph edges must be created only by actually observed public forward consequence, never hidden maze map. This is an engineered native memory/planning hypothesis, not novel cognitive architecture proof.
learning: During original FIT, R2 cells learn unchanged on all real public action-consequence transitions. R3 graph memory is reset per episode, built only from that episode's real public observations and actual transitions. In heldout unfamiliar worlds, R2 model weights fixed; ephemeral graph learns only actual visited obstacle outcomes, with identical online experience allowed to a conventional optimistic planner comparator. No reward-based heldout fitting.

planning.state: public current x,y,heading,goal x,y,front-blocked plus actual episodic forward edge success/fail and visit counts
planning.orientation: 0 east,1 south,2 west,3 north; do not assume movement if original observed transition differs. Observed source R2 original local sensor still used.
planning.grid: unknown map grid bounded by documented public map dimensions 0..18 for FourRooms,0..7 for Empty; this is a configured task boundary, not a hidden wall mask
planning.model: learn delta-per-heading from real FIT forward successful transitions; no invented source transitions. Online transition failures identify obstacle edges.
planning.decision: bounded Dijkstra search over current pose and heading using known failed edges forbidden, unknown forward edges cost 1.35, observed free edges cost 1.0, turn cost .35, per-visited-state-cost .05; next action is first of lowest-cost plan to publicly observed goal. R2 native local inhibitory score resolves exact ties only. Do not use BFS expert trajectory as the output.
planning.fallback: if no path under bounded graph, use local source-owned R2; no protected dev tuning

tests: retain learned map across a cold checkpoint while no hidden wall data
same-coordinate public obstruction learned only from physical outcome
unblocked unrelated edge not automatically prohibited
goal-directed multi-step path can require temporary movement away from goal
